content.title: UNC vs VCU, March Madness score, highlights: Terrence Hill, Rams top Tar Heels in OT
content.text: Updated March 19, 2026, 9:27 p.m. ETGREENVILLE, S.C. — UNC basketball lost in the men's 2026 NCAA Tournament against VCU, falling 82-78 in overtime.The sixth-seeded Tar Heels (24-9) blew a 19-point lead against the 11th-seeded Rams (28-7) at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, S.C., where Terrence Hill Jr. had 34 points, including the go-ahead 3-pointer with 15 seconds left in overtime.Henri Veesaar had 26 points and 10 rebounds, but UNC couldn't get to the finish line after taking a 19-point lead in the opening minutes of the second half.The Fayetteville Observer/USA TODAY Network provided live updates from the Tar Heels' opening game of the 2026 NCAA Tournament against VCU.UNC basketball score vs VCU, live updates, highlights in NCAA TournamentKeep this page bookmarked and refreshed for scores, live updates and highlights from the Tar Heels vs. Rams in the 2026 NCAA Tournament. VCU beats UNC in overtime to win NCAA Tournament gameVCU earns an 82-78 win vs. UNC in the opening round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament. Henri Veesaar misses free throws, VCU has lead with 4.2 seconds left vs UNCHenri Veesaar misses both free throws and VCU has the ball with 4.2 seconds left. Terrence Hill Jr. makes the go-ahead 3-pointer to give VCU an 80-78 lead vs UNCTerrence Hill Jr. makes the go-ahead 3-pointer to give VCU an 80-78 lead vs. UNC. Seth Trimble fouled with 35.1 seconds left for UNC vs VCUSeth Trimble split free throws to give UNC a 78-77 lead with 35.1 seconds left vs VCU. UNC, VCU tied at 77 in final minuteUNC and VCU tied at 77 with 49.7 seconds left. Heavy legs, missed shots, tense moments. The Tar Heels have missed their last eight shots and the Rams have missed six of their last seven VCU takes lead in overtime before UNC ties it at free-throw lineNyk Lewis makes the layup with 2:08 left in overtime to give VCU its first lead since midway through the second half. Seth Trimble gets steal, UNC and VCU going to overtimeSeth Trimble got a steal on the inbounds pass with 2.9 seconds left and missed a 3-pointer as time expired. UNC and VCU are going to overtime. UNC turnover gives VCU chance for game-winning shotUNC turnover with 2.9 seconds left and VCU will get a chance for a game-winning shot. Terrence Hill Jr ties game for VCU, UNC takes timeout with 8.1 seconds leftTerrence Hill Jr. has 31 points after making the game-tying layup with 11 seconds left. UNC timeout with 8.7 seconds left. Terrence Hill Jr. up to 29 points, VCU trailing UNC with 31 seconds leftTerrence Hill Jr. is up to 29 points for VCU, which trials 75-73 with 31 seconds left vs. UNC after Nyk Lewis split two free throws. Henri Veesaar splits free throw, UNC up 75-70 vs VCU with 2 minutes leftHenri Veesaar splits free throws, UNC up 75-70 vs VCU with 2 minutes left Terrence Hill Jr. scoring for VCU, Derek Dixon keeping UNC aheadTerrence Hill Jr. is trying to get VCU all the way back, but Derek Dixon has made back-to-back winning plays (mid-range jumper, lob to Henri Veesaar) to fend the Rams' leading scorer off. Hill has 27 points. UNC up 74-70 with 2:14 left. Timeout Tar Heels. VCU 9-0 run trims UNC lead to 70-65VCU closes the gap to five points with a pair of three-point plays. UNC up 70-65 with 4:12 remaining. The Rams have all of the momentum. Nyk Lewis makes it eight-point game for VCU vs UNCVCU has trimmed UNC's lead to 70-62 with under five minutes left after a three-point play by Nyk Lewis Jarin Stevenson makes 3-pointer, UNC increases lead to 14 vs VCUPost touch for Henri Veesaar results in a wide-open 3-pointer for Jarin Stevenson. UNC back out to a 14-point lead. UNC basketball has 11-point lead vs VCU in second halfVCU's hanging around with 7:30 left to play. UNC's lead down to 11 at the under-8 timeout. This is as close as the Rams have been since the opening two minutes of the second half. VCU trims UNC lead to 12 points, Tar Heels regain composureVCU trimmed UNC's lead to 61-49 midway through the second half, but Jonathan Powell made a layup through contact to push the advantage back out to 15 after a three-point play. The Tar Heels have a 64-49 lead with 10:14 left to play. Henri Veesaar up to 20 points, UNC has 61-47 lead vs VCUHenri Veesaar has 20 points and UNC has a 61-47 lead with 11:30 left to play. Jarin Stevenson three-point play gives UNC 18-point lead vs VCU in NCAA TournamentJarin Stevenson with a three-point play from the dunker spot. UNC has its largest lead of the evening, 48-30, three minutes into the second half. The Tar Heels have 26 points in the paint. Seth Trimble halftime interview with CBS reporter Tracy WolfsonSeth Trimble on why UNC is up 11 at halftime vs. VCU: "Defensive intensity. We're doing the right things on the defensive end and it's allowing us to get in transition and get some easy ones. It's really working for us." Seth Trimble on Henri Veesaar, who has 13 points and five rebounds at halftime: "He does everything for this team. He's an incredible player and we need it from him. We need it in the second half." The Tar Heels have a 15-point lead. Seth Trimble picks up second foul late in first half, UNC has 12-point lead vs VCUTwo UNC starters, Seth Trimble and Jarin Stevenson, have two first-half fouls. The Tar Heels have a 36-24 lead with 1:03 left in the first half vs. VCU.UNC dominating final 11 minutes of first half vs VCU in NCAA TournamentIt's a 25-11 stretch for UNC since VCU took a 10-7 lead, including an 18-6 run. Tar Heels getting out in transition with a 7-0 advantage in fast-break points. Seth Trimble, Henri Veesaar dunks key UNC run vs VCU in March MadnessSeth Trimble jumps into the passing lane for a steal that leads to a two-handed hammer. Henri Veesaar follows with a outback dunk to give UNC its biggest lead at 32-21 with 3:10 left in the first half. Derek Dixon making 3-pointers, continuing hot shooting for UNC vs VCUUNC's Derek Dixon staying hot from 3-point range. He's made two in the last two minutes against VCU. Dixon is now 11 of 16 (68.7%) from beyond the arc in the last two-plus games. The Tar Heels have a 24-18 lead at the under-8 timeout. Seth Trimble, UNC basketball running vs VCUGood job by Kyan Evans getting his hands in there to create a steal. Seth Trimble, at his best in the open court, finishes a fast-break layup. It's a 7-0 run for UNC, which has a 24-18 lead (8:34 1H). UNC getting paint points, but Tar Heels can't hit 3-pointers vs VCUUNC has scored 10 of its 13 points in the paint (along with three free throws). The Tar Heels have missed their first six shots from 3-point range, including four good looks for Jonathan Powell and Luka Bogavac. Tar Heels and VCU tied at 13.Jarin Stevenson picks up second foul early in first half for UNC vs VCUJarin Stevenson was tagged with his second foul with just under 14 minutes left in the first half. Stevenson exited the game as UNC's leading scorer with five points. UNC has an 11-10 lead with 13 minutes left before halftime. VCU uses 8-0 run against UNC to take early lead at first timeout in NCAA Tournament gameThe Tar Heels continue to have trouble with switches. The miscommunication and mismatches have led to three layups for VCU, which has an 8-5 lead with 15:36 left in the first half.
